'''''Rumex azoricus''''' is a species of sorrel in the family [[Polygonaceae]]. It is [[endemic]] to the [[Azores]], [[Portugal]].

==Distribution and habitat==
''Rumex azoricus'' has been observed in five of the nine Azorean islands, specifically in [[São Miguel Island|São Miguel]], [[Terceira Island|Terceira]], [[São Jorge Island|São Jorge]], [[Faial Island|Faial]] and [[Corvo Island|Corvo]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Rumex azoricus |url=https://www.catalogueoflife.org/data/taxon/4TPJT |publisher=[[Catalogue of Life]] |access-date=8 December 2020}}</ref> It lives in [[caldera|caldeiras]], watercourses and natural meadows. In São Jorge it also appears in clearings of coastal forests of ''[[Erica azorica]]'' and ''[[Myrica faya]]''.<ref>{{cite web |title=Rumex azoricus Rech.f. |url=https://acores.flora-on.pt/#/1rumex+azoricus |publisher=Flora-on |access-date=8 December 2020}}</ref>
